item.title: Anomalous quantum oscillations reveal new physics in a topological insulator
item.description: A study has been published in Nature Communications that identifies an unusual regime of quantum oscillations in a three-dimensional topological insulator. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Brass-making technology reached southern China through ancient sea routes
item.description: Ancient crucibles found in Guangzhou offer new insights into early brass production methods. These ninth and tenth-century vessels show that local cementation techniques were employed. Residues indicate craftspeople produced brass locally rather than importing finished goods. Lead-isotope analysis suggests local raw material sources were utilised. The findings point to wider technological connections with the Islamic world through maritime trade. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: World off-track on nearly every food system goal, latest assessment reveals
item.description: The latest study from the Food Systems Countdown Initiative (FSCI) reveals the stark reality of where global food systems transformation stands: for most indicators on health, environment, livelihoods, governance and resilience, a vast majority of countries will not meet the internationally agreed 2030 goals.
